question: In the Pixhawk status LED table, what does the blue ACT (Activity) LED indicate in bootloader usage and in APP usage?
reference_answer: The blue ACT (Activity) LED flutters when the bootloader is receiving data; when the application (APP) is running it is an indication of ARM state.

question: Which parameter sets the Battery Failsafe Level for the low battery failsafe, and what action is that level normally used to trigger?
reference_answer: The Battery Failsafe Level is set by BAT_CRIT_THR, the percentage capacity at which the Return action is triggered (or other actions if a single action is selected). Warn level is BAT_LOW_THR, emergency (land immediately) is BAT_EMERGEN_THR, and the action itself is COM_LOW_BAT_ACT.

question: What are the default maximum horizontal velocity and yaw rate in multicopter Position slow mode, compared with normal Position mode, and which parameters set them?
reference_answer: Position slow mode: horizontal velocity MC_SLOW_DEF_HVEL (3 m/s) and yaw rate MC_SLOW_DEF_YAWR (45 deg/s). Position mode: horizontal velocity MPC_VEL_MANUAL (10 m/s) and yaw rate MPC_MAN_Y_MAX (150 deg/s).

question: In the table of failsafe actions, what does the Flight termination action do, and where does it rank in severity?
reference_answer: Flight termination is the most severe failsafe action (the list is ordered by increasing severity). It turns off all controllers and sets all PWM outputs to their failsafe values (e.g. PWM_MAIN_FAILn, PWM_AUX_FAILn), which can be used to deploy a parachute or landing gear; a fixed-wing vehicle may be able to glide to safety.

question: What are the steps to land a multicopter in Position mode?
reference_answer: 1. Position the drone horizontally above the landing spot using the roll and pitch stick. 2. Let go of the roll and pitch stick and give it time to come to a complete stop. 3. Pull the throttle stick down gently until the vehicle touches the ground. 4. Pull the throttle stick all the way down to accelerate land detection. 5. The vehicle lowers propeller thrust, detects the ground and automatically disarms (by default).

question: How do I perform a complete compass calibration in QGroundControl?
reference_answer: Start QGroundControl and connect the vehicle; select the Q icon > Vehicle Setup > Sensors; click the Compass sensor button (autopilot orientation should already be set); click OK to start; place the vehicle in each orientation shown in red, hold it still and, when the image turns yellow, rotate it around the specified axis until the image turns green; repeat for all orientations until QGroundControl shows Calibration complete.

question: What are the steps to calibrate the ESCs with QGroundControl?
reference_answer: Remove the propellers; map the ESCs as motors in Actuator Configuration; unpower the ESCs by unplugging the battery while keeping the flight controller powered (e.g. via USB); open QGroundControl Settings > Power and press Calibrate; power the ESCs when prompted so calibration begins automatically (ESC beeps indicate the steps); when complete, go back to Actuator Configuration and verify the minimum (default 1100us), maximum (default 1900us) and disarmed (default 1000us) motor values.

question: What is the procedure for running auto-tuning on a multicopter?
reference_answer: Perform the pre-tuning test; take off using RC in Altitude mode and hover a few metres above ground (4-20 m); in QGroundControl open Vehicle setup > PID Tuning, select the Rate Controller or Attitude Controller tab, make sure Autotune enabled is on, read the warning and click OK; the drone performs quick roll, then pitch and yaw motions with progress shown next to the Autotune button; then manually land and disarm to apply the new parameters and carefully test that the vehicle is stable.

question: What does a solid purple UI LED mean on a Pixhawk-series flight controller?
reference_answer: Solid purple means Failsafe Mode: the vehicle has encountered an issue in flight such as loss of manual control, a critically low battery or an internal error, and will try to return to its takeoff location or descend where it is.

question: Where in QGroundControl can I put a Spektrum receiver into bind mode?
reference_answer: In QGroundControl under Radio Setup > Spectrum Bind.

question: Where do I find the option to reset all parameters to the firmware defaults in QGroundControl?
reference_answer: On the Parameters screen, open the Tools menu at the top right of the screen and choose Reset all to firmware defaults.

question: Which tune does PX4 play when the home position is initialised?
reference_answer: The Home Set Tune, played when the home position is initialised (first time only).
